title: Little glowing glass-like being with a triangle
place_text: Woods near his house, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And when I described this little being, I said he looked like glass.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man from North Carolina who says he draws UFOs to him, says that in 2007 he met a small glowing being in the woods near his house. He describes it as looking like it was made of glass, and he ties a triangle to the encounter. If true, it would be a direct meeting with a being that is not human.
